name: Everything at once: seven overlapping calls with a closure, a jam, a breakdown and a priority change
intent: A 25-minute demo script where events overlap: two calls in the same minute, a call that arrives while two others are on the road, a duplicate caller, a closure on a route, a jam, a feed that goes stale, an ambulance that breaks down with a patient aboard, a hospital that reports less capacity and a patient who gets worse.

clock.t_s: seconds since the script origin; the first model minute is t_s = 120, ISO times are local (UTC+1)

dashboards.er: inbound ambulances, ETA, type, vitals, treatments, alerts, handover
dashboards.crew: events for one unit (filter by unit)
dashboards.map: positions from vehicles[].track, road events, reroutes
